class.name: IfcMonetaryUnit
class.brief_description: IfcMonetaryUnit is a unit to define currency for money. HISTORY: New entity in IFC Release 2x. IFC2x4 CHANGE: Type of the attribute Currency changed.

members.member: Code or name of the currency. Permissible values are the three-letter alphabetic currency codes as per ISO 4217 , for example CNY, EUR, GBP, JPY, USD. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a String, one of the enumeration's values in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
